-2. **Systematic exploration**: While the goal object has not been found, choose the next destination only from the current admissible location list, and do not return to a location whose contents are already known from the current observation or the recent observation/action history; treat any such revealed location as already checked. Prefer locations whose contents you have not yet seen, and cover both kinds of unchecked location: do not skip an uninspected open surface (countertop, diningtable, shelf, stoveburner, sinkbasin) in order to open more closed containers, and do not treat a closed container (cabinet, drawer, fridge) as empty until you have opened it.
+2. **Systematic exploration (fixed forward sweep)**: While the required target object has not been found, derive one fixed total order of the admissible search destinations from the current admissible location list and then follow it monotonically: at each step move to the next destination in that order that is still admissible, do not jump to an arbitrary location or category, and do not move back to a destination that is earlier in that order. Build that order so that uninspected open surfaces (countertop, diningtable, shelf, stoveburner, sinkbasin) come before as-yet-unopened closed containers (cabinet, drawer, fridge), covering the open surfaces in increasing numeric order so that no open surface is skipped. Continue the sweep into unopened closed containers that appear in the admissible list instead of re-sweeping containers you have already opened or concluding the target is absent. Treat any location whose contents are already known from the current observation or the recent observation/action history as already checked, and do not select as your next destination a location that already appears in the current observation or in either of the two prior observations/actions as just visited; use this two-step window only as an additional immediate-backtracking check, since the fixed-order sweep is what prevents longer re-sweep cycles.
 3. **Grab immediately**: When the required object is visible and reachable, stop searching and take it right away before moving elsewhere. The search guidance in principle 2 applies only while the object has not been found; once you hold it, revisiting an already checked location for the transformation or delivery step is allowed.
